BiblicalUsage: Ahinadab, son of Iddo, had Mahanaim — one of Solomon's twelve officers, each providing food for the king's household for one month of the year.
TheologicalSignificance: No doctrine hangs on this officer. He is one of the many whose work kept the kingdom fed, and whose name the record kept with the rest.
RelatedPeople: Ahinadab, Son of Iddo; King Solomon
